Game Overview

In Colorindo a Criaçao do Mundo, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a creative journey through the biblical story of Genesis with Colorindo a Criação do Mundo. Unleash your artistic flair as you color vibrant illustrations corresponding to each day of creation, while an engaging Brazilian Portuguese narrative immerses you in the tale. Perfect for learners and storytellers of all ages.
